prompt: For the upcoming AlphaTraderTV video on monthly options income ($14k October P&L using iron condors), identify the primary keyword, long-tail variations, search intent, opportunity score, and placement guidance for title/description/tags/chapters.
raw_output:
The primary keyword for this video is 'iron condor strategy' — 38,500 monthly US searches, difficulty 52, informational intent skewing transactional (viewers want to learn AND replicate). It's the load-bearing term across title, description, tags, and at least one chapter title.

The stronger SEO play, however, is a long-tail stack. 'Iron condor monthly income' (14,800 vol, difficulty 38) is the differentiation keyword; combine it with the primary in the title for compound ranking. 'Monthly options income breakdown' (5,400, 26) and 'iron condor real P&L' (4,400, 24) are exact-match thumbnail/description plays. 'Options income $1000 month' (9,600, 32) is the beginner-funnel sister term.

Intent breakdown: 62% of searches are educational-explanatory ('what is', 'how does'), 28% are execution-focused ('how to', 'setup', 'when to'), 10% are validation ('does it work', 'real results'). This video should serve all three — open with execution proof, walk through mechanics, close with results validation.

Placement: primary keyword in first 40 characters of title, exact-match in first 150 chars of description, in tag #1, in chapter title for the setup section, in pinned comment, in Shorts CTAs. Long-tail 'monthly options income' should appear in description body, tag #2, and one mid-chapter title. Opportunity score is high — composite 0.81 — driven by ranking-page weakness (no competitor combines real fills + named strikes + monthly view) and AlphaTraderTV's existing topical authority in options income.

structured_output.placement_notes: Primary keyword in first 40 chars of title, first 150 chars of description, tag #1, setup chapter title, pinned comment, Shorts CTAs. 'Iron condor monthly income' compound-stacked in title for differentiation. Long-tail 'monthly options income' in description body + tag #2 + mid-chapter.
